slides.headline: HE TURNED $0 INTO $45 BILLION IN ONE YEAR
slides.body: He left OpenAI at 23, wrote a viral 165-page AI essay, and launched a hedge fund. In 12 months it hit $45 billion. Nobody could explain how

slides.headline: HE BET $4 FOR EVERY $1 HE HAD
slides.body: His fund used 400% leverage: for every $1, he borrowed $3 more and bet it all on AI stocks. Insiders said the blowup was 'not if, but when'

slides.headline: HE FIRE-SOLD EVERYTHING IN ONE WEEK
slides.body: His lenders demanded billions he didn't have. He dumped every position to Ken Griffin's Citadel at a steep discount. $45 billion crashed to $10 billion

slides.headline: IT HAPPENED THE WEEK OF HIS WEDDING
slides.body: His fiancée is chief of staff to Anthropic's CEO. He also held a multibillion-dollar stake in her company. The collapse and his wedding landed in the same week

slides.headline: THE SAME MISTAKE COST HIM $35 BILLION
slides.body: He went all in with no exit plan. Most businesses do the same with AI. The ones winning got someone to build it right and prove it pays for itself first

slides.headline: THIS WON'T BE THE LAST BLOWUP
slides.body: More funds are making the same 400% bets right now. Follow, you'll want to see who's next. Send this to the friend who thinks AI stocks only go up

caption:
Leopold Aschenbrenner's $45 billion AI fund collapsed to $10 billion in one week. Swipe to see how it happened 🔥

He left OpenAI at 23, wrote a viral 165-page essay about AI, launched a hedge fund called Situational Awareness in July 2024, gained over 1,000% and peaked at $45 billion using 400% leverage on AI stocks, got margin-called when the market dipped, fire-sold everything to Ken Griffin's Citadel at a steep discount, and watched it crash to $10 billion the same week as his wedding to Anthropic CEO's chief of staff

The AI gold rush is creating and destroying fortunes faster than anything Wall Street has seen. When 400% leverage meets one bad week, billions vanish overnight. Save this as a reminder of what happens when hype outpaces the plan.
